# LabelOne & BuilderOne Industrial Suite

> Industrial scale integration, label printing, and automated workflow engine for Java applications.

## Summary
The LabelOne & BuilderOne Industrial Suite is a high-performance cross-platform industrial software framework developed in Java. It provides real-time weighing scale data acquisition, dynamic thermal label rendering, and custom automation via native hardware drivers and scripting engine integration.

## Key Technical Specifications
- **Core Technology**: Java 17 / Java 21, Java Swing GUI framework.
- **Hardware Abstraction**: Low-level MMIO hardware interaction, serial/USB scale interface.
- **Native Modules**: C++ JNI (Java Native Interface) and JNA (WinSpool) components.
- **Embedded Environment**: Linux (Debian Bookworm) on Raspberry Pi 4 B and Raspberry Pi 5, optimized systemd fast-boot kiosk setups.
- **Scripting Engine**: Embedded JavaScript (Mozilla Rhino) execution engine for dynamic dynamic runtime rules and custom label printing logic.
- **Thermal Printer Support**:
  - TSPL / TSPL2 (TSC printers)
  - ZPL (Zebra Technologies printers)
  - Raw command generation, bitmap compression algorithms, and real-time status feedback parsing.
